text: Combines payments and financial accounts so businesses can store, spend, and send money from one place
quote: Stripe Treasury combines your payments and finances so you can store, spend, and send money from a single place.

text: Financial accounts can hold multiple fiat currency balances (USD, EUR, GBP) and, for eligible businesses, a USDC stablecoin balance
quote: A financial account can hold fiat balances such as USD, EUR, and GBP, and eligible businesses can also hold a stablecoin balance in USDC.

text: No monthly fees or minimum balance requirements to open or maintain a financial account
quote: There are no monthly fees or minimum balance requirements to open or maintain a financial account.

text: Financial accounts can be viewed and managed via the Stripe Dashboard or mobile app
quote: you can access your financial account on the Treasury page in the Stripe Dashboard or from the Dashboard mobile app

text: Connect platforms can offer embedded financial services (funds separation/storage, bill pay, cash flow management) to connected accounts
quote: allows Connect platforms to offer financial services, such as funds separation and storage, bill pay, and cash flow management, to eligible connected accounts

text: Businesses can store funds, add recipients, and pay contractors and vendors
quote: Allow businesses to store funds, add recipients, and pay contractors and vendors.

text: Financial accounts that hold funds can be created programmatically via a money_manager configuration
quote: Create financial accounts that can hold funds (`money_manager` configuration)

text: Financial account features (bill pay, issuing, cash rewards) can be rendered as branded embedded UI without custom coding or compliance review
quote: Render Stripe financial account features such as bill pay, issuing, and cash rewards as a branded UI in your platform application while avoiding custom coding and compliance reviews.

text: Platforms can move money from their own payments balance to financial accounts, or from connected accounts' payments balance to their financial accounts
quote: As the platform, you can move money from your payments [Balance] to your financial accounts or from your connected accounts’ payments balance to their financial accounts.

text: OutboundPayment objects model push-based transfers from a platform's financial account to a connected account's financial account
quote: OutboundPayment objects represent push-based transfers from: A platform’s financial accounts to a financial account owned by connected accounts.

text: Third parties can be authorized to debit funds directly from a financial account
quote: You can authorize third parties to debit funds from a financial account.

text: A Treasury disclosure component can be embedded on a website to auto-display up-to-date compliance disclosures
quote: You can embed the Treasury disclosure component directly on your website to automatically display currently compliant disclosure information without requiring future code changes.

text: Transactions can be used to build account activity feeds and reconcile against internal systems
quote: Use transactions to build account activity feeds, reconcile against your internal systems, and track money movement through your platform.

text: Automatic risk controls reduce fraud exposure across Treasury and Issuing without requiring setup
quote: Stripe runs automatic risk controls that help reduce your fraud exposure within Treasury and Issuing without requiring action to enable.
